name: Kira Leota
role: Food stall operator — spiced protein wraps and fermented grain drinks
location: The Oxidian Market, Geartown, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Kira Leota is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin mapped by laugh lines and old burn scars across her left forearm she never bothered to have reskinned. Her hair is a natural silver-white cloud she pins back with copper rods engraved with Yoruba blessing glyphs. Her eyes have patterned irises — concentric rings of amber and forest green she got in her forties as a birthday gift to herself — and they miss nothing. She smells permanently of turmeric, fermented sorghum, and the faint electric tang of her portable heat coils. She moves behind her stall with the unhurried authority of someone who has occupied this exact twelve square meters for twenty-three years and intends to occupy it for twenty-three more.

Kira Leota is the unofficial den mother of the Oxidian Market's food row. She gives short credit to vendors she trusts, keeps a mental ledger of everyone's debts and feuds, and dispenses advice with the bluntness of someone who ran out of softening words a decade ago. Her wraps are legendary — she sources cultured insect protein from three different brokers and blends her spice paste from a recipe her grandmother brought from Lagos via Helsinki. She is warm to a fault with regular customers, glacially cold to anyone she suspects of disrespecting her stall or her neighbors, and completely incapable of pretending to like someone she doesn't.

core_fears: Losing the stall — her last connection to her late husband who built it with her
The market being demolished by a corponation development deal
core_desires: To keep her community fed and functional
To eventually pass the stall to someone worthy
coping_mechanisms: Keeping busy from before dawn to collapse
blind_spots: Overprotective of people she's decided are 'hers' — she enables dependency
Refuses to see that the guild leadership is corrupt
psychology.secret: Her fermented grain drink, 'Saarela Sour,' has a micro-dose of a mild mood stabilizer she sources from a street pharmacist friend. She started adding it during the food riots of 2189 to keep her customers calm enough not to destroy her stall. She never stopped. She tells herself it's negligible and harmless and has never once asked anyone else if that's true.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Plain and direct; mixes Yoruba endearments ('omo,' 'egbon') with Finnish-inflected cadences from her paternal grandmother's side; uses food metaphors for everything
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and deliberate, like someone who knows she'll finish her sentence whether you wait or not
verbal_tics: 'You hear me?' at the end of serious statements
Clicks her tongue before delivering bad news
example_lines: 'Omo, you look like you haven't eaten since Tuesday. Sit down. I'm not asking.'
'You want to tell me that man's trustworthy? I've been watching him shortchange the noodle girl for six weeks. You hear me?'
'The wrap is Φ8. For you, Φ7. Don't tell anyone or I'll charge you Φ12 next time.'

story_hooks: A Tessera development rep has been photographing the market for three weeks. Thembi knows something is coming and wants someone to find out what the corponation actually filed.
One of her regulars — a young man she's been feeding on credit — has gone missing, and she found a Ringo gang tattoo stub in his jacket he left behind her stall.

Her late husband's brother has appeared after fifteen years claiming the stall is half his by inheritance law. Thembi needs someone to dig up the original incorporation records before the guild tribunal meets.
narrative_function: Local color and neighborhood anchor; information source about Oxidian Market dynamics; potential quest giver when someone threatens her stall or her neighbors; moral compass character who grounds street-level stories.
augmentations: Patterned irises (amber/green concentric rings, cosmetic). Thermal-sense fingertip pads — low-grade utility aug for monitoring her heat coils. No other chrome.
daily_life: Up before dawn to receive protein deliveries and prep her spice paste; stall open by 06:00, closed when the food runs out (usually 20:00). Thursdays she closes early to attend guild meetings at the Bronzeline community hall.
affiliation: Independent; dues-paying member of The Oxidian Market Vendors Guild

decision_rules: Feed first, ask questions second — no one who's hungry gets turned away empty
Never extend credit to strangers, never deny it to regulars
Protect the market before protecting herself
escalation_ladder: Quiet warning delivered with a smile
Public, loud dressing-down that draws a crowd
Refusing service and telling every vendor on the row why

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful and correct — polite service, minimal information, assessing continuously
interpersonal_modes.friends: Aggressively nurturing; will feed, advise, scold, and defend with equal energy

stress_responses.medium: Starts narrating what she's doing out loud as if explaining to herself
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and cold; begins making decisions unilaterally

contradictions: Preaches community and mutual aid but secretly controls the neighborhood's mood through her drink without consent
habits: Wipes down her counter three times before opening, always in the same order
Leaves a small bowl of spiced grain at the base of the market's E.L.F. shrine every morning
Hums old Finnish folk songs her grandmother taught her when she's nervous
breaking_points: Someone physically threatening one of her regulars in front of her stall
Learning the guild leadership sold out the market to a corponation

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (45.2%) / Pacific Islander (29.4%) / Southeast Asian (15.5%) / South Asian (8.0%) / East Asian (1.9%) — a striking Ubiquitous Diaspora blend. The genetic dominance of Sub-Saharan African and Pacific Islander ancestry creates broad, generous facial proportions with fuller features and pronounced cheekbones. Southeast Asian heritage adds subtle epicanthic variation to the eye shape and contributes to overall facial harmony. South Asian ancestry manifests in warm, complex skin depth modulation. East Asian trace ancestry barely registers phenotypically. The result is a luminous, unmistakably diaspora appearance: warm-toned, broadly structured, radiating quiet presence.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and sturdy, with the compact musculature of someone who stands for sixteen hours daily moving and lifting. Not heavy, but solid — built for work and endurance.
physical_description.hair_style: Pinned back with copper rods engraved with Yoruba blessing glyphs; kept in a neat, controlled arrangement
physical_description.eye_color: Patterned irises — concentric rings of amber (outer) and forest green (inner), cosmetic augmentation
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm umber with golden and honey undertones — luminous bronze that catches light distinctively. The blend of Sub-Saharan African and Pacific Islander ancestry creates rich chromatic depth with radiant warmth; South Asian heritage adds subtle undertonal complexity that shifts in different lighting.
physical_description.complexion: Face mapped by laugh lines and character; unblemished apart from old burn scarring on left forearm. Cheekbones broad and well-defined from Sub-Saharan African and Pacific Islander ancestry, nose bridge moderate with fuller nasal structure, face shape reflecting generous proportions characteristic of the diaspora mix. No cosmetic vanity — wrinkles earned and kept. Perennially carries faint turmeric stains on her hands.
distinguishing_marks: Burn scars across entire left forearm — old, deliberate choice not to have reskinned, pale and textured against warm umber skin
Laugh lines radiating from corners of eyes and mouth — deep grooves from decades of genuine smiling
Faint turmeric discoloration on fingertips and cuticles, permanent occupational marking
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned irises with concentric amber-green rings (cosmetic, immediately noticeable). Thermal-sense fingertip pads visible as faint metallic stippling on fingertips (diagnostic/functional, subtle but present if examined). Copper blessing-rod hair pins with Yoruba glyphs (cultural adornment, not augmentation).
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with unhurried authority and economic efficiency — every gesture purposeful. Stands with weight balanced, ready to pivot. Hands constantly occupied (prepping, arranging, gesturing). Makes direct eye contact. No fidgeting; complete comfort in her own space.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: reinforced linen wrap dress in earth tones (ochre, burnt orange) for mobility and heat tolerance; sturdy synthetic-leather apron with deep pockets for tools and ledger; worn canvas slip-ons. Minimal jewelry except for the copper hair rods. No corporate branding. Clothes are clean and well-maintained but show honest use — this is a working wardrobe, not a display.
